view: PA frontal chest radiograph (L marker on image right, conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Adequate: erect PA, trachea midline, minimal rotation, adequate inspiration (~6 anterior ribs) and penetration; scapulae partially project over the upper lateral lung fields; no L/R reversal.

abnormalities.finding: Homogeneous opacity with laterally rising meniscus obliterating the costophrenic angle and obscuring the hemidiaphragm - moderate pleural effusion (approx. 7 cm vertical height at the lateral chest wall)
Probable adjacent basal atelectasis/consolidation behind the effusion (lung base not separable from the fluid)
Unfolded/tortuous thoracic aorta with prominent aortic knob (age-related; possible mural calcification)
Prominent, slightly ill-defined right hilum (enlarged pulmonary artery vs hilar adenopathy) - uncertain
Increased bronchovascular/interstitial markings with mild crowding at the right base; right costophrenic angle essentially preserved
Small ring-like calcified density adjacent to the anterior end of the right 1st rib - most likely calcified 1st costal cartilage (benign), calcified granuloma less likely

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（PA），氣管居中，未見任何管路、導線、節律器或外部裝置。左下肺野見均質性緻密影，外側上緣呈新月狀向上延伸，左側肋膈角消失、左橫膈面模糊，符合中等量左側肋膜積液，並可能合併其後方之下葉肺塌陷或實質化；右側肋膈角大致保留，右下肺野支氣管血管紋理略增加。心影擴大（心胸比約0.55–0.60），胸主動脈迂曲、主動脈結突出，右肺門略顯突出；右上肺野第一肋軟骨前端處見小片環狀鈣化影，多為良性肋軟骨鈣化，骨骼結構未見明顯骨折或溶骨病灶。
